title: Aa asghar
body:
aa ali asghar aa
<<DIVIDER>>
aa asghar bin tere mai chain kahan se paaun
aa laut ke aaja laal tere jee bhar ke naaz uthaun
<<DIVIDER>>
meri aankh ka taara hai tu mujhko jaan se pyara hai
maa dukhiyari ke jeene ka tu hi laal sahara hai
tujhe chod ke tanha maqtal mein mai kaise shaam ko jaaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
<<DIVIDER>>
teri wo masoom adayein teri yaad dilaati hai
tere pyar ki wo sab baatein mujhko bahot rulaati hai
mai teri judaai mein beta ro ro ke mar na jaaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
<<DIVIDER>>
loriyon waale ye to tere naaz uthanae ke din thay
aankhon mein teri khushiyon ke khwab sajane ke din thay
aa laut ke asghar aa beta tera kurta mai badlaaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhool nahi sakti maa asghar pyase hont tere beta
khali godh hai aur zindan hai aaja maa ke pass aaja
aa nanhe mujahid mai teri ashkon se pyas bhujaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni hai bechain sakina tere naaz uthane ko
subho shaam tarasti hai wo tera dil behlane ko
teri laadli behan sakina ka mai dil kaise behlaaun
aa asghar bin tere...
aa laut ke aaja laal...
author: N. Sarwar & J. Jaffri
